summary: Positron Corporation filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting entry into material definitive agreements: three unsecured promissory notes totaling $2,000,000 issued September 30, 2026, bearing 20% interest, with $1,500,000 to affiliated investor George Ortiz, $400,000 to TISU Investments LTD (controlled by Director Tis Prager), and $100,000 to an unrelated third party. Warrants for 300,000, 80,000, and 20,000 shares at $2.00 exercisable through December 31, 2030 were issued. Ortiz also exercised 300,000 warrants at $1.50 for $450,000. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
